senses.gloss: अन्व्-अक्ष mfn. (fr. 4. अक्ष), following, L.
अन्व्-अक्षम् ind. afterwards, immediately after, R. &c. cf. g. शरद्-आदि
अन्व्-अक्षरम् ind. according to the sound or letter, SaṃhUp.
अन्व्-अक्षर-सन्धि m. a kind of Sandhi in the Vedas, RPrāt.
अन्व्-अग्रम् ind. from below to above, ib.
अन्व्-अङ्ग॑म् ind. after every member or part, ŚBr.
for every part of an action, ŚBr.
अन्व॑ञ्च् mfn. अङ्, ऊची॑ and ऊ॑ची, अक् (√ अञ्च्), following the direction of another, going after, following
lying lengthwise
अन्व॑क् ind. afterwards
अन्व॑क् ind. behind (with acc.)
अन्वक्-स्थानिन् or अन्वक्-स्थानीय, mfn. inferior in dignity, Āpast.
अन्वक्-स्थानिन् or अन्वक्-स्थानीय, mfn. inferior in dignity, Āpast.
अन्वग्-ज्येष्ठ mfn. the next eldest, ib.
अन्वग्-भावम् ind. afterwards, L.
friendly disposed, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 64.
अन्वग्-भूय ind. becoming friendly disposed, ib.
अन्व्-√ अञ्ज् to anoint, ŚBr.; Kauś.
अन्व्-√ अत् (P. -अतति), to go after, follow, ĀpŚr.
अन्व्-अति-√ सिच् to pour out over or along, TBr.
अन्व्-अती (√ इ) cl. 2. P. -अत्येति, to pass over to, follow, ŚBr.
अन्व्-अधि-√ रुह् to ascend after another, Lāṭy.
अन्व्-अध्य्-√ 2. अस् to throw upon after another, MānŚr.
अन्व्-अध्यायम् ind. according to the chapters (of the Veda), according to the sacred texts, Nir.
अन्व्-अप-√ क्रम् to run away after another, TBr.
अन्व्-अभि-षिच् (√ सिच्) Ā. -सिञ्चते to have one's self anointed by another (with acc.), MBh. xii, 2803 (both editions).
अन्वभ्य्-अव-√ चर् to come near, MaitrS.
अन्व्-अभ्यवचा॑रम् ind. creeping after, MaitrS.
अन्व्-अय m. (√ इ See अन्व्-√ इ), following, succession
connection, association, being linked to or concerned with
the natural order or connection of words in a sentence, syntax, construing
logical connection of words
logical connection of cause and effect, or proposition and conclusion
drift, tenor, purport
descendants, race, lineage, family.
अन्व्-अय See p. 46, col. 1.
अन्व्-अय—ज्ञ m. a genealogist.
अन्व्-अय—वत् mfn. having a connection (as a consequence), following, agreeing with
belonging to race or family
अन्व्-अय—वत् ind. in connection with, in the sight of Mn. viii, 332.
अन्व्-अय—व्यतिरेक n. agreement and contrariety
a positive and negative proposition
species and difference
rule and exception
logical connection and disconnection.
अन्व्-अय—व्यतिरेकिन् mfn. (in phil.) affirmative and negative.
अन्व्-अय—व्याप्ति f. an affirmative argument.
अन्वयागत mfn. inherited, Pañcat.
अन्वयिन् mfn. connected (as a consequence)
belonging to the same family, Rājat.
अन्वयि-त्व n. the state of being a necessary consequence.
अन्व्-√ अर्च् to honour with shouts or songs of jubilee, RV. v, 29, 2.
अन्व्-√ अर्ज् to let go, ŚBr.

अन्वर्तितृ॑ for अनु-वर्तितृ m. a wooer, RV. x, 109, 2.
अन्व्-अर्थ mf(आ)n. conformable to the meaning, agreeing with the true meaning, Ragh. iv, 12
having the meaning obvious, intelligible, clear.
अन्व्-अर्थ—ग्रहण n. the literal acceptation of the meaning of a word (as opposed to the conventional).
अन्व्-अर्थ—संज्ञा f. a term whose meaning is intelligible in itself (opposed to such technical terms as भ, घु, &c.)
अन्व्-√ अव् to encourage, RV. viii, 7, 24.
अन्व्-अव-√ 1. कृ to despise, refuse, MaitrS.
अन्व्-अव-√ 1. कॄ to scatter or strew about (with instr.), Yājñ.
अन्व्-अवकिरण n. scattering about successively, L.
अन्व्-अव-√ क्रम् to descend or enter in succession, ŚBr. xiv.
अन्व्-अव-√ 1. गा to go and join another, ŚBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ चर् to insinuate one's self into, enter stealthily, TS. &c.
अन्व्-अवचार m. See अ॑न्-अन्ववचार.
अन्व्-अव-√ धा to place into successively, ĀpŚr.
अन्व्-अव-√ 1. पा Ved. Inf. -पातोः, to drink after others, ŚāṅkhBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ प्लु -प्लवते, to dive after, TBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ मृश् to touch or come in contact with or along, Gobh.
अन्व्-अव-√ रुह् to ascend or enter upon after another, MBh.
अन्ववलम्ब mfn. hanging down along (acc.), Gobh.
अन्व्-अव-√ लुप् Pass. -लुप्यते, to drop off after another, PBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ सृज् to let go along or towards, TS.; TBr.
अन्व्-अवसर्ग m. letting down, slackening, TPrāt.; Pat.
permission to do as one likes, Pāṇ. i, 4, 96.

अन्व्-अव-√ सो -स्यति, to adhere to cling to, TBr. &c.;
to long for, desire, ŚBr. &c.
अन्व्-अव-सायि॑न् mfn. adhering to, depending on (gen.), TS.; ŚBr.
अन्व्-अव-सित mfn. seized by, ŚāṅkhBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ स्था to descend after another, ŚBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ स्रु Caus. -स्रावयति, to cause to flow down upon or along, TS.; TBr.; ŚBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ हन् to throw down by striking, ŚBr.
अन्व्-अव-√ हृ to lower (the shoulder), ŚāṅkhGṛ.

अन्व्-अवार्ज् (√ अर्ज्) to cause to go after or in a particular direction, ŚBr.;
to afflict with (instr.), AitUp.
अन्व्-अवास् (√ 2. अस्), to place upon (dat.), TS.
अन्व्-अवे (√ इ) cl. 2. P. -अवैति, to follow, walk up to or get into.
अन्व्-अवाय m. race, lineage, MBh.
अन्व्-अवायन n. See अ॑न्-अन्ववायन.
अन्व्-अवेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्) to look at, inspect.
अन्व्-अवेक्षण n. looking after, inspection, MBh.
अन्व्-अवेक्षा f. regard, consideration.
अन्व्-अवेक्षिन् mfn. circumspect, considerate, ib.
अन्व्-√ 1. अश् cl. 5. P. Ā. -अश्नोति, -नुते, to reach, come up to, equal, RV.; AV.
अन्व्-अष्टका f. the ninth day in the latter half of the three (or four) months following the full moon in Āgrahāyaṇa, Pauṣa, Māgha (and Phālguna), Mn. iv, 150
अन्वष्टक्य n. a Śrāddha or funeral ceremony performed on the Anvaṣṭakās.
अ॑न्व्-अस्त mfn. (√ 2. अस्), shot along, shot
interwoven (as in silk), chequered, ŚBr.
अन्व्-√ अह् perf. -आह, to pronounce (especially a ceremonial formula, ŚBr. &c.)
अन्व्-अह॑म् ind. day after day, every day.
अन्वा (for 2. अनु-वा, q.v.), blowing after, TāṇḍyaBr.; GopBr.
अन्व्-आकर्षक mfn. attracting from the preceding, TPrāt.
अन्व्-आ-√ 1. कृ to give to any one to take with him, to give a portion to a daughter, ŚāṅkhBr.
अन्व्-आ-कृति f. shaping after, imitation, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अन्व्-आ-√ क्रम् Ā. to ascend towards or to, TS. : P. to visit in succession, BhP.
अन्व्-आ-क्शा॑यम् ind. (क्शा for ख्या), reciting successively, MaitrS.
अन्व्-आ-√ ख्या to enumerate, Lāṭy.
अन्व्-आख्या॑न n. an explanation keeping close to the text, ŚBr.
a minute account or statement, Pat.
अन्व्-आख्यायक mfn. stating exactly or explicitly, Pat.

अन्व्-आ-√ गम् to follow, come after, VS.; ŚBr. &c.:
Desid. -जिगांसति, to wish or intend to follow, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आ-√ गा to follow, RV. i, 126, 3.
अन्व्-आ-√ चक्ष् to name after, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आ-√ चम् to follow in rinsing the mouth, ĀśvGṛ.
अन्व्-आचय m. (√ चि), laying down a rule of secondary importance (after that which is प्रधान, or primary)
connecting of a secondary action with the main action (e.g. the conjunction च is sometimes used अन्वाचये).
अन्व्-आचय—शिष्ट mfn. propounded as a rule or matter of secondary importance.
अन्व्-आचित mfn. secondary, inferior.
अन्व्-आ-√ चर् to follow or imitate in doing, BhP.
अन्वाजे (√ अज्?), only used in connection with √ 1. कृ, e.g. अन्वाजे कृ to support, aid, assist, Pāṇ. i, 4, 73.

अन्व्-आ-√ तन् to extend, spread, RV. viii, 48, 13, &c.;
to overspread, extend over, VS.
अन्व्-आ-√ 1. दा Ā. to resume, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आ-√ दिश् to name or mention afresh, Pāṇ.
अन्व्-आदिष्ट mfn. mentioned again, referring to a previous rule, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 190.

अन्व्-आदेश m. mentioning after, a repeated mention, referring to what has been stated previously, re-employment of the same word in a subsequent part of a sentence, the employment again of the same thing to perform a subsequent operation.
अन्व्-आदेशक mfn. referring to a previous statement, TPrāt.

अन्व्-आ-√ धा to add in placing upon, place upon: Ā. and P. to add fuel (to the fire), AitBr. &c.;
to deliver over to a third person (in law).
अन्व्-आधान n. adding or putting fuel (on the three sacred fires)
depositing.
1. अन्व्-आधि m. a bail or deposit given to any one for being delivered to a third person, Gaut.
a deposit delivered to another person to be handed over to a third, Gaut.
2. अन्व्-आधि m. repentance, remorse, L.
अन्व्-आ-√ धी to recollect, remember, think of AV.; TĀr.
अन्व्-आधेय or अन्व्-आधेयक, अम्, n. property presented after marriage to the wife by her husband's family, Mn. &c.
अन्व्-आधेय or अन्व्-आधेयक, अम्, n. property presented after marriage to the wife by her husband's family, Mn. &c.
अन्व्-आहित mfn. deposited with a person to be delivered ultimately to the right owner.
अन्व्-आ-हित See अन्व्-आ-√ धा.
अन्व्-आ-√ 1. धाव् to run after, Kāṭh.
अन्व्-आध्य॑ m. pl. a kind of divinity, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आ-√ नी to lead to or along.
अन्व्-आ-√ नु Intens. -नो॑नवीति, to sound through, RV. x, 68, 12.
अ॑न्व्-आन्त्र्य mfn. being in the entrails, AV.

अन्व्-√ आप् to attain, reach, AitBr. :
Desid. अन्व्-ईप्सति, to harmonize in opinion, agree, VP.
अन्व्-आपदीन m. N. of a king (v.l. अल्लाप्˚), Sāh.
अन्व्-आ-√ भज् P. and Ā. to cause to take a share after or with another, ŚBr. &c.
अन्व्-आ-भक्त mfn. entitled to take a share after or with another.
अन्व्-आ-√ भू to imitate, equal, TS. &c.
अन्व्-आ-√ यत् Caus. -यातयति, to dispose or add in regular sequence, bring into connection with (loc. or abl.), ŚBr. &c.
अन्व्-आ॑-यत्त mfn. (with loc. or acc.) connected with, being in accordance with, being entitled to, TS. &c.
अन्व्-आयात्य mfn. to be brought in connection with, to be added, to be supplied, ĀśvŚr.
अन्व्-आयतन mfn. latitudinal.
अन्व्-आर॑भ्य mfn. to be touched from behind, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आरम्भ॑ m. touching from behind, TBr.; KātyŚr.
अन्व्-आरम्भण n. id., KātyŚr.
अन्व्-आरम्भणीया f. an initiatory ceremony, KātyŚr.
अन्व्-आरोह॑ m. pl. N. of certain Japas uttered at the Soma-libations, TS.
अन्व्-आरोहण n. (a widow's) ascending the funeral pile after or with the body of a husband, (g. अनुप्रवचनादि, q.v.)
अन्व्-आरोहणीय mfn. belonging to the Anvārohaṇa, or rite of cremation, ib.
अन्व्-आ-√ लभ् to lay hold of grasp, handle, take in the hand or with the hand, RV. x, 130, 7, &c.
अन्व्-आलभन or अन्व्-आलम्भन, अम्, n. a handle (?), MBh. iii, 17156.
अन्व्-आलभन or अन्व्-आलम्भन, अम्, n. a handle (?), MBh. iii, 17156.
अन्व्-आ-√ लोच् Caus. -लोचयैर्, to consider attentively.
अन्व्-आ-√ 2. वप् ‘to scatter in addition’, to add, Kauś.
अन्व्-आ-√ वह् to convey to or in the proximity of RV. x, 29, 2.

अन्व्-आ-√ विश् to enter, occupy, possess;
to follow, act according to ChUp. &c.
(Caus. -वर्तयति), to change, Divyāv.
अन्व्-आवृत॑म् ind. with regard to order or succession, ŚBr.
अन्व्-आ-√ शी to lie along, be extended over, AV.
अन्व्-आ-श्रित mfn. (√ श्रि), one who has gone along
placed or situated along.
अन्व्-आसन n. sitting down after (another)
service
regret, affliction, L.
a place where work is done, manufactory, house of industry, L.
an unctuous or cooling enema, L.
अन्व्-आसीन mfn. sitting down after, seated alongside of.
अन्व्-आस्यमान mfn. being accompanied by, attended by.
अन्वासेचन n. sprinkling, Kauś.
अन्व्-आ-√ स्था to go towards, to meet, attain, VS. &c.
अन्व्-आस्थान n. (TBr., Sch.) attainment.
अन्व्-आस्थाय m. (TBr.) attainment.
अन्व्-आ-√ हृ to make up, supply, ŚBr. &c.
अन्व्-आ-हरण n. making up, supplying Comm. on Lāṭy.
अन्व्-आ-हार m. id., Lāṭy.
अन्व्-आहार्य᳙ m. a gift, consisting of food prepared with rice, presented to the Ṛtvij priest at the Darśapūrṇamāsa ceremonies, TS. &c.
अन्व्-आहार्य᳙ (अम् or अकम्), n. the monthly Śrāddha (q.v.) held on the day of new moon (according to Mn. iii, 123 it should be of meat eaten after the presentation of a Piṇḍa or ball of rice).

अन्व्-आ-√ हिण्ड् (P. -हिण्डति), to wander, Divyāv.
अन्व्-आ-√ ह्वे to call to one's side in order or after another, Kauś.

joined, attended, accompanied by, connected with, linked to
having as an essential or inherent part, endowed with, possessed of, possessing
acquired
reached by the mind, understood
following
connected as in grammar or construction.

अन्व्-ईत mfn. = अन्व्-इत, Bālar.
अन्वितार्थ mfn. having a clear meaning understood from the context, perspicuous.
अ॑न्व्-इति f. following after, VS.
अन्व्-ईयमान mfn. being followed.
अन्विच्छा f. seeking after, ib.
अन्व्-√ इध् or अन्व्-√ इन्ध्, to kindle, AV.
अन्व्-√ इध् or अन्व्-√ इन्ध्, to kindle, AV.

अन्व्-इष्ट or अन्व्-इष्यमाण, mfn. sought, required.

अन्व्-एष, अस्, m. [Śāk.] or अन्व्-एषण, अम्, आ, n., f. seeking for, searching, investigating.
अन्व्-एषक, mf(इका)n. or अन्व्-एषिन् or अन्व्-एष्टृ [Pāṇ. v, 2, 90, &c.], mfn. searching, inquiring.
अन्व्-एषक, mf(इका)n. or अन्व्-एषिन् or अन्व्-एष्टृ [Pāṇ. v, 2, 90, &c.], mfn. searching, inquiring.
अन्व्-एषक, mf(इका)n. or अन्व्-एषिन् or अन्व्-एष्टृ [Pāṇ. v, 2, 90, &c.], mfn. searching, inquiring.

अन्व्-√ ईक्ष् to follow with one's looks, to keep looking or gazing, AV. &c.;
to keep in view, ŚBr.
अन्व्-ईक्षक mf(इका)n. careful, anxious, R.

अन्व्-ईक्षण, अम्, n. or अन्व्-ईक्षा, f. examining, inquiry Comm. on Nyāyad.
 meditation, BhP.

अन्व्-ईक्षण, अम्, n. or अन्व्-ईक्षा, f. examining, inquiry Comm. on Nyāyad.
 meditation, BhP.
अन्व्-ईक्षित॑व्य mfn. to be kept in view or in mind, ŚBr.
अन्व्-ईप॑म् ind. (fr. 2. अप्), along the water, along the river, MaitrS.
cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 98, Sch.
अन्व्-√ ऋ (cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति) aor. Ā. -अर्त, to follow in rising, RV. v, 52, 6.
अन्व्-ऋच॑म् ind. verse after verse, ŚBr.
अ॑न्व्-ऋजु mfn. moving straight forwards or in the right way (N. of Indra), MaitrS.
अन्व्-√ ऋध् cl. 6. P. -ऋध॑ति, to carry out, accomplish, RV. vii, 87, 7.

आन्वयिक mf(ई)n. (fr. अन्व्-अय), of a good family, well born, L.
आन्वाहिक mf(ई)n. (fr. अन्व्-अह), daily, Mn.
आन्वीक्षिकी f. (fr. अन्व्-ईक्षा), logic, logical philosophy, metaphysics, MBh.; Mn.; Gaut. &c.
(also, with बुद्धि) an argumentative mind, R.
आन्वीपिक mfn. (fr. अन्व्-ईप), being along (the water)
conformable (?), Pāṇ. iv, 4, 28.
